problem.statement: Garnet's launch-convergence history, active mission pointers, Rust baseline, and remaining backlog must be frozen into one internally consistent, evidence-bounded source of truth before deeper launch work resumes.
successCriteria: The #497 through #506 first-parent checkpoint records every exact squash-main SHA in observed merge order
Mission resume pointers resolve only to the materialized P7 phase and its four tasks
One Rust MSRV is declared consistently and enforced inside existing CI contexts
Every frozen-backlog claim names current code and fresh evidence or remains honestly partial or planned

definitionOfDone.claim: PR #499 archives every mainline merge from d0d4f7cc through 1fe7489 with exact PR-to-main-SHA mappings
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: git log --first-parent d0d4f7cc..1fe7489 --oneline | every PR number must resolve to its squashed main SHA in the archive; any unmapped PR falsifies
every phase id referenced by resume.activePhase and resume.nextActions must exist in phases[]; a reference to a non-existent phase falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: one Rust MSRV is settled and enforced by CI
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: grep the declared MSRV across workspace manifests and CI config; two distinct values (e.g. 1.75+ and 1.95+) falsifies

definitionOfDone.claim: the frozen backlog contains no claim that cannot tie to current code plus fresh evidence
definitionOfDone.falsifiedBy: for each backlog claim, name its evidence file; any claim without one must be marked partial or planned, or the freeze falsifies

confidence.biggestRisk: A prose-only reconciliation could hide a stale phase pointer or promote an unevidenced launch claim.
confidence.nextAction: Reconcile the mission archive and generate the namespaced Lane 0 kickoff state while launch remains HOLD.

rejectedAlternatives.idea: Continue launch slices from the stale multi-phase resume pointer
rejectedAlternatives.reason: P8, P9, and P10 were never materialized in phases[], so continuing from them would violate mission referential integrity.
